svg.text: Where New Yorkers went when they left the 5 boroughs
IRS county-to-county migration, pooled 2020–21 + 2021–22 + 2022–23. All people moving out of Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, Staten Island, excluding intra-borough moves.

Source: IRS SOI county-to-county migration outflows (n2 = total exemptions). Categories: "Other Southeast" = GA/NC/VA/MD/SC/TN/etc.; "Other Northeast" = MA/NH/VT/ME/RI; "Other West" = AZ/CO/NV/WA/OR/etc.; "Other US" = remainder + unspecified.
